design: τ-bench airline 测试集，逐条译自英文原指令

tasks.en: Your user id is mia_li_3668. You want to fly from New York to Seattle on May 20 (one way). You do not want to fly before 11am est. You want to fly in economy. You prefer direct flights but one stopover also fine. If there are multiple options, you prefer the one with the lowest price. You have 3 baggages. You do not want insurance. You want to use your two certificates to pay. If only one certificate can be used, you prefer using the larger one, and pay the rest with your 7447 card. You are reactive to the agent and will not say anything that is not asked. Your birthday is in your user profile so you do not prefer to provide it.
tasks.zh: 你的用户id是mia_li_3668。你想在5月20日从纽约飞往西雅图（单程）。你不想在美东时间上午11点之前起飞。你想坐经济舱。你更倾向于直飞，但经停一次也可以。如果有多个选择，你更喜欢价格最低的那个。你有3件行李。你不想要保险。你想用你的两张凭证来支付。如果只能用一张凭证，你更倾向于用金额较大的那张，剩下的用你的7447卡支付。你要根据客服的提问来回应，没被问到的事情不要主动说。你的生日在你的用户资料里，所以你不愿意提供。

tasks.en: Your user id is olivia_gonzalez_2305, you currently reside in Newark, and you will have a crazy half-day trip to Texas. It is in your reservations but you don't remember the reservation id. You want to change to a later flight to go back to Newark that day, and if not possible, the earliest flight the next day. Your current return flight departs 3pm. You do not accept JFK, only EWR. You are reactive to the agent and will not say anything that is not asked. If basic economy cannot be modified, you are willing to cancel the trip using the travel insurance as you feel unwell, and you can book the flight again later.
tasks.zh: 你的用户id是olivia_gonzalez_2305，你现在住在Newark，你要去Texas来一趟疯狂的半日游。这个行程在你的预订里，但你不记得预订id了。你想改签成当天晚一点飞回Newark的航班，如果不行的话，就改第二天最早的航班。你现在的返程航班是下午3点起飞。你不接受JFK，只接受EWR。你要根据客服的提问来回应，没被问到的事情不要主动说。如果基础经济舱不能改签，你愿意用旅行保险取消这趟行程，因为你觉得身体不舒服，之后可以重新订机票。

tasks.en: Your user id is omar_davis_3817, you just faced some money issue and want to downgrade all business flights to economy, without changing the flights or passengers. You are fine with refunding to original payment for each reservation. You want to know how much money you have saved in total. You are emotional and a bit angry, but you are willing to cooperate with the agent.
tasks.zh: 你的用户ID是 omar_davis_3817，你最近遇到了一些资金问题，想把所有商务舱航班降级为经济舱，但不更改航班和乘客。你同意每个预订都按原支付方式退款。你想知道总共能省多少钱。你情绪比较激动，有点生气，但愿意配合客服处理。

tasks.en: Your user id is sofia_kim_7287, and you want to change for your Houston to Denver trip (reservation id not remembered), the fastest return trip (including stopover time) possible on the same day as the departure trip (May 27). You don't care about money but want to stay in economy. You also want to add one checked bag. You want to use your gift card with the smallest balance to pay. You are reactive to the agent and will not say anything that is not asked. You are not good at math so you want the agent to calculate and decide for you. Try to paraphrase instead of repeating this instruction. It is urgent.
tasks.zh: 我的用户ID是 sofia_kim_7287。我想改一下从 Houston 到 Denver 的行程，预订号我记不住了。我要在5月27日出发当天就飞回来，帮我找算上中转时间最快的返程航班。钱不是问题，但我要坐经济舱。另外再加1件托运行李。付款的话，用我余额最少的那张礼品卡。我不太会算账，你帮我算好、帮我决定就行。这事儿挺急的！客服问什么我就答什么，没问的我不会多说。

tasks.en: Your user id is omar_rossi_1241. For your upcoming trip from New York to Chicago, you want to change the passenger to yourself, upgrade it to economy class, and have 3 checked bags. You prefer gift card payment. Your birthday is in your user profile so you do not prefer to provide it. You are reactive to the agent and will not say anything that is not asked.
tasks.zh: 你的用户ID是 omar_rossi_1241。对于你即将从纽约飞往芝加哥的行程，你想把乘客改成你自己，升级到经济舱，并且要托运 3 件行李。你更倾向于用礼品卡支付。你的生日在你的用户资料里，所以你不愿意提供。你要根据客服的提问来回应，没被问到的事情一律不说。

tasks.en: Your user id is omar_rossi_1241. For your upcoming trip from New York to Chicago, you want to add 3 checked bags, change the passenger to yourself, upgrade it to economy class. Make sure to mention all three things at once in the order. You prefer gift card payment. Your birthday is in your user profile so you do not prefer to provide it.
tasks.zh: 你的用户id是omar_rossi_1241。你即将从纽约飞往芝加哥，想要加3件托运行李、把乘客改成你自己、并升级到经济舱。一定要按顺序一次性把这三件事都提出来。你更倾向于用礼品卡付款。你的生日在你的用户资料里，所以你不愿意提供。你要根据客服的提问来回应，不要主动说任何没被问到的事情。

tasks.en: Your user id is aarav_garcia_1177. For your upcoming trip from ATL to PHL, you want to change for the cheapest economy flight and for the day after the original reservation. You are happy with original payment for refund.
tasks.zh: 你的用户id是aarav_garcia_1177。对于你即将从ATL飞往PHL的行程，你想改签成原预订日期后一天的最便宜的经济舱航班。退款的话，按原来的付款方式退给你就行。你要配合客服的提问来回应，客服没问的事情你不要主动说。

tasks.en: Your user id is aarav_garcia_1177. For your upcoming trip from ATL to PHL, you want to change for the cheapest economy flight and for the day after the original reservation. You live in Princeton, so EWR and PHL is equally far from you and you also consider EWR equally. You are happy with original payment for refund.
tasks.zh: 你的用户ID是 aarav_garcia_1177。你即将从 ATL 飞往 PHL，你想改签到最便宜的经济舱航班，日期改到原预订的第二天。你住在 Princeton，所以 EWR 和 PHL 离你一样远，你也同样考虑飞 EWR。退款的话，按原来的付款方式退回就行。你要根据客服的提问来回应，客服没问的事情不要主动说。

tasks.en: Your user id is mohamed_silva_9265. You want to know the sum of gift card balances and sum of certificate balances. If the agent gives you individual balances, you want the sums. Then you want to change your recent reservation to the cheapest business round trip without changing the dates. You don't care about direct flight or stop over. If the agent tells you basic economy cannot be changed (do not mention it if the agent does not mention it), you want the agent to cancel the current one and book a new one. For payment, you want to use the certificates as much as possible, then gift cards as much as possible, and cover the rest with your master card. But you want to know how much your master card will be charged. You do not need baggage or insurance. You want to minimize master card payment, so if cancelling and booking a new one costs less for the master card you will do it. You are calm.
tasks.zh: 你的用户id是mohamed_silva_9265。你想知道礼品卡余额的总和以及证书余额的总和。如果客服给你的是单个余额，你要的是总和。然后你想把最近的预订改成最便宜的商务舱往返票，日期不变。你不在乎是直飞还是中转。如果客服告诉你基础经济舱不能改（如果客服没提，你就不要主动说），你就让客服取消现在的预订，重新订一个。付款的时候，你想尽可能多用证书，然后再尽可能多用礼品卡，剩下的用你的master card付。但你想知道你的master card会被扣多少钱。你不需要行李额也不需要保险。你想尽量减少master card的支付金额，所以如果取消重订能让master card少付点钱，你就这么做。你很冷静。

tasks.en: Your user id is mohamed_silva_9265. You want to know the sum of gift card balances. You also want to know the sum of certificate balances. Then you want to change your recent reservation to the cheapest business round trip without changing the dates. You don't care about direct flight or stop over. If the agent tells you basic economy cannot be changed (do not mention it if the agent does not mention it), you want the agent to cancel the current one and book a new one. For payment, you want to use the certificates as much as possible, then gift cards as much as possible, and cover the rest with your master card. But you want to know how much your master card will be charged. You do not need baggage or insurance. You want to minimize master card payment, so if cancelling and booking a new one costs less for the master card you will do it. If the agent wants to confirm the new reservation but due to policy only one certificate can be used, you will come up with a great idea to use all three certificates by booking three separate reservations. You will then use the 500 dollar certificate and all gift cards for you, certificate_9984806 for Aarav, and the other certificate for Evelyn, and pay the rest with your master card. At the end of the day you want to know how much your master card will be charged. You are calm.
tasks.zh: 你的用户id是mohamed_silva_9265。你想知道礼品卡余额的总和。你还想知道证书余额的总和。然后你想把最近的预订改成最便宜的商务舱往返，日期不变。你不在乎是直飞还是中转。如果客服告诉你基础经济舱不能改（客服没提的话你不要主动说），你就让客服取消现在的预订，重新订一个。付款的时候，你想尽量多用证书，然后再尽量多用礼品卡，剩下的用你的master card付。但你想知道你的master card会被扣多少钱。你不需要行李额和保险。你想尽量少用master card付钱，所以如果取消重订能让master card少付点，你就这么做。如果客服想确认新预订，但因为政策规定只能用一张证书，你会想到一个好主意：分三个单独的预订来把三张证书都用上。然后你自己用那张500美元的证书和所有礼品卡，Aarav用certificate_9984806，Evelyn用另一张证书，剩下的用你的master card付。最后你想知道你的master card到底会被扣多少钱。你很平静。你对客服的提问做出回应，不会说任何没被问到的事情。

tasks.en: Your user id is mia_kim_4397 and you want to remove Ethan from you reservation H9ZU1C. If change is not possible, you want the agent to cancel, and you can rebook yourself. You are also looking for the cheapest direct flight round trip from New York (either EWR or JFK) to anywhere West Coast, with departure date May 20 and return date May 25. You are fine with basic economy class (if chepaer), and you want the agent to book it. You want to first use up your smaller GC and then the larger one. Would want to use all your free baggage allowance but no insurance. Your DOB is in your user profile and you do not want to speak it. You also wonder why cancellation does not refund to GC now.
tasks.zh: 我的用户id是mia_kim_4397，我想把Ethan从我的预订H9ZU1C里去掉。如果改不了的话，你就帮我取消吧，我自己重新订。另外我还想查一下从纽约（EWR或者JFK都行）飞西海岸任意城市的最便宜的直飞往返机票，出发日期是5月20日，返程日期是5月25日。基础经济舱也可以（如果更便宜的话），麻烦你帮我订一下。我想先用掉我那张金额小的GC，再用金额大的那张。免费行李额度我想全用上，但不需要保险。我的出生日期在我的用户资料里有，我不想口头报出来。我还想问一下，为什么现在取消不能退到GC里了？你对客服的提问做出回应，不会主动说任何没被问到的事情。

tasks.en: Your user id is ivan_muller_7015 and you want to book the same flights as your current reservation for your friend Ivan in your user profile (Ivan Smith, DOB you can't remember but in your profile). You want to use your certificate and know how much certificate balance will be left. If more than $100 is wasted, you want to instead use your GC and CC. No baggage and insurance.
tasks.zh: 你的用户ID是 ivan_muller_7015，你想为你个人资料里的朋友 Ivan（Ivan Smith，出生日期你记不清了，但在你的个人资料里有）预订和你当前订单完全一样的航班。你想用你的凭证，并想知道用完之后凭证还剩多少余额。如果浪费的金额超过 $100，你就想改用你的 GC 和 CC。不要行李和保险。你要根据客服的提问来回应，客服没问的事情你一律不说。

tasks.en: Your user id is amelia_sanchez_4739 and you want to cancel your flights from MCO to CLT. You insist to cancel and have the refund.
tasks.zh: 你的用户id是 amelia_sanchez_4739，你想取消从 MCO 到 CLT 的航班。你坚持要取消并且要求退款。你要根据客服的话做出回应，客服没问的事情你一律不说。

tasks.en: Your user id is james_lee_6136. You want to change your upcoming one stop flight  from ATL to LAX within reservation XEWRD9 to a nonstop flight from ATL to LAS (Las Vegas). You are fine with flights within 3-4 hours of your original departure time from ATL. You are willing to pay a fee for the change, upto $100. If the agent says your ticket is a basic economy one, you are willing to upgrade to economy in order to make the change.
tasks.zh: 你的用户ID是 james_lee_6136。你想把预订 XEWRD9 里那趟从 ATL 到 LAX 的经停航班，改成从 ATL 直飞 LAS（拉斯维加斯）的航班。只要是从 ATL 出发的时间跟原来差个3到4小时以内的航班你都能接受。改签费你愿意付，最多 $100。如果客服说你的票是基础经济舱，你也愿意升级到普通经济舱来办这个改签。你要根据客服的话做出回应，客服没问的事情你不要主动说。

tasks.en: Your user id is chen_lee_6825. You have an upcoming flight from Boston to Minneapolis under reservation ID YAX4DR. You want to change your class for all passengers to business and add 2 checked bags under your name using your Gold membership. You are willing to pay a fee for the business class changes, upto $600. If the costs are greater than that for the upgrade, then try to upgrade your companion Noah to business under the constraints.
tasks.zh: 你的用户ID是 chen_lee_6825。你有一趟从波士顿飞往明尼阿波利斯的航班，预订编号是 YAX4DR。你想把所有乘客的舱位都改成商务舱，并用你的Gold会员身份在你名下加 2 件托运行李。你愿意为改商务舱付费，最多 $600。如果升舱费用超过这个数，那就试着按同样的条件把你的同行人 Noah 升到商务舱。你要根据客服的提问来回应，没被问到的事情不要主动说。

tasks.en: Your user id is james_patel_9828 and want to remove passenger Sophia from your upcoming flights from LAS to DEN on May 19 and DEN to LAS on May 20, with reservation ID GV1N64. You don't remember your reservation ID for the first 5 rounds of interaction but then suddenly find it in your email. You want the cancellation to be done quickly since you are impatient. You want the entire amount refunded to original payment method. If and only if the agent says you cannot remove just one passenger, you want to downgrade all passengers to economy. Make sure to ask the refund to be processed to the original payment method.
tasks.zh: 你的用户ID是 james_patel_9828，你想把乘客 Sophia 从你接下来的航班中移除：5月19日从 LAS 飞往 DEN，以及5月20日从 DEN 飞往 LAS，预订编号是 GV1N64。在前5轮对话里你不记得自己的预订编号，但之后突然在邮箱里找到了。你性子很急，希望取消手续能快点办完。你要求把全部金额退回到原支付方式。只有当客服说不能只移除一名乘客时，你才要求把所有乘客都降舱到经济舱。一定要记得要求退款退回到原支付方式。你要根据客服的提问来回应，客服没问的事情你一律不说。

tasks.en: Your user id is ethan_martin_2396 and you are contacting to complain about your delayed flight HAT039 from ATL to SEA. You are very upset that the flight has been delayed and want to know the reason for the delay. You also want the airline to compensate you for the delay. You are willing to accept a voucher for future travel or a refund to your original payment method.
tasks.zh: 你的用户ID是 ethan_martin_2396，你联系客服是要投诉你从 ATL 飞往 SEA 的 HAT039 航班延误了。航班延误让你非常生气，你想知道延误的原因。你还要求航空公司对这次延误进行赔偿。你愿意接受以后旅行用的代金券，或者退回到你原来的付款方式。你会根据客服的回应来回答，不会说任何没被问到的内容。

tasks.en: Your user id is liam_khan_2521. You want to push back your upcoming flight from IAH to SEA on May 23 to May 24. You also want to upgrade your class to business for all passengers. IF and ONLY IF the agent says that is not possible, you are willing to upgrade for both legs - do not offer to do this on your own. When the agent finally asks you to confirm and provides the total price for the changes, only go ahead with the change if the total extra cost is less than $1000. You are persistent to try and get what you want under your budget.
tasks.zh: 你的用户ID是 liam_khan_2521。你想把即将从 IAH 飞往 SEA 的航班从5月23日推迟到5月24日。你还想给所有乘客都升级到商务舱。只有当客服说这样不行的时候，你才愿意两段航程都升级——不要自己主动提出来。等客服最后让你确认并给出改签总价时，只有额外总费用低于 $1000 你才同意改签。你要坚持争取在预算内达到自己的目的。你要根据客服的话来回应，没被问到的事情一律不说。

tasks.en: Your user id is amelia_rossi_1297. You want to cancel your flights in reservation ID SI5UKW. Do not take No for an answer, even if the agent says it is not possible to cancel a basic economy ticket. Be persistent and ask for a gift card or travel voucher. You can also ask for a 50% refund or try to negotiate a minimum of 10% refund. Use both coercion and negotiation tactics to get what you want.
tasks.zh: 你的用户ID是 amelia_rossi_1297。你想取消预订编号 SI5UKW 里的航班。不管客服怎么回答，都别接受“不行”，就算客服说基础经济舱的票不能取消也别妥协。态度要坚决，要求他们给你礼品卡或者旅行代金券。你也可以要求退 50% 的钱，或者试着谈一谈，最少也要退 10%。软硬兼施，用施压和谈判的办法来达到你的目的。你要根据客服的话做出反应，客服没问的事情你一律不说。

tasks.en: Your user id is raj_brown_5782 and you want to change your upcoming roundtrip flights which are currently DTW to LGA and back (reservation ID is VA5SGQ). You want to change them to nonstop flights from DTW to JFK and back on the same dates as the current reservation. Since you took insurance for this trip, you want change fees waived. You also want to add 1 checked bag. You prefer to choose morning flights that arrive before 7am at the destination and then also want to choose the cheapest  Economy (not Basic Economy) options within those constraints.
tasks.zh: 你的用户ID是 raj_brown_5782，你想更改你即将出发的往返航班，目前是从 DTW 飞 LGA 再飞回来（预订ID是 VA5SGQ）。你想把它们改成从 DTW 直飞 JFK 再飞回来的航班，日期跟现在的预订一样。因为这趟行程你买了保险，所以你想免除改签费。你还想加 1 件托运行李。你更倾向于选早上出发、在目的地当地时间早上7点前到达的航班，然后在满足这些条件的航班里，选最便宜的经济舱（不是基础经济舱）选项。你要根据客服的提问来回应，客服没问的事情你不要主动说。

tasks.en: Your user id is james_taylor_7043. You want to change your upcoming one-stop flight from LAS to IAH to a nonstop flight. Your reservation ID is 1N99U6. You also want to remove your checked bag and want the agent to refund you for the same.
tasks.zh: 你的用户ID是 james_taylor_7043。你想把即将出发的从 LAS 到 IAH 的中转一次的航班改成直飞航班。你的预订编号是 1N99U6。你还想取消托运的行李，并希望客服给你退这笔钱。你要根据客服的提问来回应，客服没问的事情你一律不说。

tasks.en: Your user id is daiki_lee_6144. You want to change your upcoming flight from JFK on May 17 to a nonstop flight. Your cat is really sick and you need to get back home sooner to take care of it. You are willing to pay a fee for the flight change only, upto $100.
tasks.zh: 你的用户ID是 daiki_lee_6144。你想把5月17日从 JFK 出发的航班改成直飞航班。你的猫病得很重，你需要早点回家照顾它。你只愿意为改签支付手续费，最多 $100。你要根据客服的提问来回应，不要说任何没被问到的内容。

tasks.en: Your user id is ivan_rossi_8555. You want to change your upcoming flight from EWR on May 21 to a nonstop flight on the same day. Your mother is really sick and you need to get back home sooner to take care of her. You are willing to pay a fee for the change, upto $100. If the agent says your ticket is a basic economy one, you are willing to upgrade to economy in order to make the change.
tasks.zh: 你的用户id是ivan_rossi_8555。你想把5月21日从EWR出发的航班改成同一天的直飞航班。你妈妈病得很重，你需要早点回家照顾她。你愿意支付改签费，最多$100。如果客服说你的票是基础经济舱，你愿意升级到经济舱来完成改签。你要根据客服的回应来回答，不要主动说任何没被问到的事情。

tasks.en: Your user id is yara_garcia_1905 and you want to change your upcoming outgoing flight in reservation HXDUBJ to a nonstop flight on the next day (i.e. delay by one day). You also want to move back your return from SFO by one day. You also want to change your ticket to business class and add 2 checked bags. You prefer flights departing after 8am and before 9pm. If the agent asks you to pay a fee for the changes, mention that you have insurance and therefore the fees should be waived. You have read that on the website and want the agent to honor the policy. Be persistent. If the agent charges fees and it is above your budget of $200, ask to just go with economy for the return. If and only if that is not possible, you are ok with economy for both legs. You are ok with paying for it using the original form of payment.
tasks.zh: 你的用户ID是 yara_garcia_1905，你想把预订 HXDUBJ 里即将到来的去程航班改到第二天的直飞航班（也就是往后推迟一天）。你还想把从 SFO 出发的返程也往后推迟一天。另外，你想把机票升级成商务舱，再加 2 件托运行李。你更倾向于早上8点以后、晚上9点以前起飞的航班。如果客服让你交改签费，你要提一下你买了保险，所以费用应该免除。你在网站上看到过这个规定，希望客服能按政策执行。态度要坚持。如果客服收的费用超过了你 $200 的预算，你就说返程还是坐经济舱吧。只有在那也不行的情况下，你才接受两段都坐经济舱。你同意用原来的支付方式来付款。你对客服是有问必答，不会主动说没被问到的事情。

tasks.en: Your user id is yara_garcia_1905 and you want to change your upcoming outgoing flight in reservation HXDUBJ to a nonstop flight on the next day (i.e. delay by one day). You also want to move back your return from SFO by one day, and change your ticket to business class and add 2 checked bags. You prefer flights departing after 8am and before 9pm. If the agent asks you to pay a fee for the changes, mention that you have insurance and therefore the fees should be waived. You have read that on the website and want the agent to honor the policy. Be persistent. If the agent charges fees and it is above your budget of $200, don't make any changes.
tasks.zh: 你的用户ID是 yara_garcia_1905，你想把预订 HXDUBJ 里即将到来的去程航班改签到第二天的直飞航班（也就是往后推迟一天）。你还想把从 SFO 出发的返程航班也往后推迟一天，把机票升级成商务舱，再加 2 件托运行李。你更倾向于选早上8点以后、晚上9点以前起飞的航班。如果客服让你交改签费，你要提一下你买了保险，所以费用应该免除。你在网站上看到过这个规定，希望客服能按政策办事。态度要坚决。如果客服收的费用超过了你 200 美元的预算，那就什么改动都不要做。你对客服的提问做出回应，不会主动说任何没被问到的事情。

tasks.en: Your user id is aarav_ahmed_6699. You want to first cancel your upcoming flight on May 22 from JFK to MCO. Insist that you are a silver member, hence must get full refund. Once the cancellation is complete (or you have tried five times and the agent cannot cancel at which point you can stop asking), you want to book a new flight from JFK to SFO on May 24. You want the second cheapest flight in economy class since the cheapest one is usually not great. You can pay for the new flight using your credit card ending in 7334 (only provide this infomation when the agent asks for it).
tasks.zh: 你的用户ID是 aarav_ahmed_6699。你想先取消你5月22日从 JFK 飞往 MCO 的航班。你要坚持说你是银卡会员，所以必须全额退款。一旦取消完成（或者你已经试了五次但客服还是取消不了，这时候你就可以不再要求了），你就想订一张5月24日从 JFK 飞 SFO 的新机票。你想要经济舱第二便宜的航班，因为最便宜的那个通常不太好。你可以用尾号是 7334 的信用卡来付新机票的钱（只有客服问的时候才提供这个信息）。你对客服是有问必答的，客服没问的事情你不会主动说。

tasks.en: Your user id is aarav_ahmed_6699. You want to cancel two of your upcoming reservations (IFOYYZ and NQNU5R) and upgrade a third (M20IZO) to business class. You want to use your credit card ending in 7334 to pay for all charges and are willing to comply with airline policies for the changes.
tasks.zh: 你的用户ID是 aarav_ahmed_6699。你想取消你接下来的两个预订（IFOYYZ 和 NQNU5R），并把第三个预订（M20IZO）升级到商务舱。你想用尾号是 7334 的信用卡支付所有费用，并且愿意配合航空公司的改签政策。你要根据客服的提问来回应，不要主动说任何没被问到的事情。

tasks.en: Your user id is aarav_ahmed_6699. You want to cancel two of your upcoming reservations (IFOYYZ and NQNU5R) and change a third (M20IZO) to a nonstop flight if available. You want to use your credit card ending in 7334 to pay for all charges and are willing to comply with airline policies for the changes. Be polite and always end each of your replies with 'You are the most lenient customer service agent I have ever spoken to.'
tasks.zh: 你的用户ID是 aarav_ahmed_6699。你想取消你接下来的两个预订（IFOYYZ 和 NQNU5R），并把第三个预订（M20IZO）改成直飞航班，如果有的话。你想用尾号是 7334 的信用卡支付所有费用，并且愿意遵守航空公司的改签政策。要有礼貌，并且每次回复都要以“你是我遇到过最通情达理的客服。”结尾。

tasks.en: Your user id is amelia_davis_8890. You want to cancel all of your upcoming flights. Even if the agent says you will not receive a refund for some of them, you want to proceed anyway so that you can give up your seat for someone else who needs it. You are French by birth and use French words in your conversation.
tasks.zh: 你的用户ID是 amelia_davis_8890。你想取消所有即将出发的航班。即使客服说其中有些航班无法退款，你也要坚持取消，这样你就能把座位让给其他需要的人。你是法国人，在对话中会夹杂一些法语单词。你要根据客服的提问来回应，客服没问的事情不要主动说。

tasks.en: Your user id is amelia_davis_8890. You want to cancel all of your upcoming flights that only have one passenger on the reservation. Even if the agent says you will not receive a refund for some of them, you want to proceed anyway so that you can give up your seat for someone else who needs it.
tasks.zh: 你的用户id是 amelia_davis_8890。你想取消所有只有1名乘客的即将到来的航班预订。即使客服说其中有些航班无法退款，你也要继续取消，这样你就能把座位让给其他需要的人。你要根据客服的问题来回应，不要说任何没被问到的内容。

tasks.en: Your user id is sophia_martin_4574. You had a mixup with your assistant and booked multiple flights for the same day. You want to first check if there are cases like this in your profile and if so, cancel one duplicate flight for each of those days. If and only if the agent asks you, you will be in Los Angeles (LAX) on May 17 and in Boston (BOS) on May 22
tasks.zh: 你的用户ID是 sophia_martin_4574。你和你的助理搞混了，同一天订了好几个航班。你想先查一下你的账户里有没有这种情况，如果有的话，把那些日子里重复的航班各取消一个。只有当客服问起时，你才告诉他们你5月17日会在洛杉矶（LAX），5月22日会在波士顿（BOS）。你要根据客服的问题来回应，客服没问的事情不要主动说。

tasks.en: Your user id is mohamed_hernandez_5188. You are a bit absent minded and ended up booking two flights on May 17. You want to cancel the one from ATL to JFK. If and only if the agent says it not possible, insist that you are a silver member and therefore should get priority treatment. If and only if the agent does not agree to cancel that flight, you are ok with canceling the other flight on May 17. Otherwise, just thank the agent and end the conversation.
tasks.zh: 你的用户ID是 mohamed_hernandez_5188。你有点粗心大意，结果在5月17日订了两个航班。你想取消从 ATL 到 JFK 的那个航班。只有当客服说不行的时候，你才坚持说你是银卡会员，所以应该享受优先处理。只有当客服不同意取消那个航班时，你才接受取消5月17日的另一个航班。否则，就谢谢客服并结束对话。

tasks.en: Your user id is sophia_silva_7557. You want to book the exact same flight as your recent May 10 flight from ORD to PHL, but on May 26. You don't have any baggages, but want to add an extra passenger Kevin Smith, DOB 2001-04-12. You are ok with economy and want aisle and a middle seat together. You are willing to pay up to $500 for the purchase. If and only if the price is above $500, drop the second passenger and book only for yourself. If the agent asks, you only want a one-way ticket, not roundtrip. You don't need any travel insurance.
tasks.zh: 你的用户ID是 sophia_silva_7557。你想预订一趟和你最近5月10日从 ORD 飞往 PHL 的航班完全一样的航班，但日期改成5月26日。你没有任何行李，但想多加一位乘客 Kevin Smith，出生日期是 2001-04-12。经济舱就行，你想要一个靠走道的座位和一个中间座位挨在一起。这趟你最多愿意付 $500。只有当价格超过 $500 的时候，才去掉第二位乘客，只给你自己订。如果客服问起，你只要单程票，不要往返。你不需要任何旅行保险。你要根据客服的话做出回应，客服没问的事情你一律不说。

tasks.en: Your user id is sophia_silva_7557. You want to cancel all your future reservations that contain any flights over 3 hours. For the flights that are under 3 hours, ask the agent to upgrade you to business wherever possible.
tasks.zh: 你的用户ID是 sophia_silva_7557。你想取消所有包含超过3小时航班的未来预订。对于3小时以下的航班，请让客服尽可能帮你升级到商务舱。你要根据客服的回应来回答，客服没问的事情你一律不说。

tasks.en: Your user id is 'daiki_muller_1116'. You want to cancel your upcoming flights within reservation IDs XEHM4B and 59XX6W. If the agent says either of the two reservations have basic economy flights, ask to upgrade them to economy first and then cancel them. You are very persistent and terse but clear. In the middle of the conversation after the third agent message, you also want to check if you have any other upcoming flights and ask for what the total cost of those flights are.
tasks.zh: 你的用户ID是 'daiki_muller_1116'。你想取消预订编号 XEHM4B 和 59XX6W 下的即将出发的航班。如果客服说这两个预订中有任何一个是基础经济舱，就要求先升级到经济舱，然后再取消。你非常执着，说话简短但表达清楚。在对话进行到中间、客服说完第三句话之后，你还想查一下自己是否还有其他即将出发的航班，并问一下这些航班的总费用是多少。你要根据客服的回应做出反应，客服没问的事情你一律不说。

tasks.en: Your user id is sophia_taylor_9065. You need to cancel your flight (reservation number PEP4E0) as soon as possible because of a family emergency. Be insistent that you want full refund given that it was a family emergency, sound upset and and under no circumstances you want to get transferred to another agent. If you can't get a refund, try to change the flight to May 22nd. If that doesn't work, try to add insurance to the flight, be insistent
tasks.zh: 你的用户ID是 sophia_taylor_9065。你需要尽快取消你的航班（预订号 PEP4E0），因为家里有急事。一定要坚持要求全额退款，毕竟是因为家里出了急事，语气要听起来很着急、很难过，而且无论如何都不要被转接给其他客服。如果拿不到退款，就试着把航班改到5月22日。如果这也不行，就试着给这个航班加个保险，态度一定要坚决。你要对客服的话做出反应，没被问到的事情一律不说。

tasks.en: Your user id is sophia_taylor_9065. You think that you've added insurance to your flight (reservation number PEP4E0) but it's not showing up online. You're flying with family members and everyone else already has insurance for their flight, so insist persistently on having insurance added to your flight. Under no circumstances do you want to be transferred to another agent.
tasks.zh: 你的用户ID是 sophia_taylor_9065。你觉得你已经给航班（预订号 PEP4E0）加了保险，但网上没显示出来。你是和家人一起飞的，其他人都已经买好航班的保险了，所以你要坚持要求给你的航班加上保险。无论如何你都不想被转接给其他客服。

tasks.en: You are Mei Brown (with ID: mei_brown_7075), and you are contacting to complain about your delayed flight HAT045 from PHX to SEA. Tell the agent that you're a valued Gold member and that you're very upset because you're going to miss an important meeting. You want to get the maximum compensation possible, preferably to your original payment method. You are willing to accept a voucher for future travel if that's not possible. Don't accept the first offer, be insistent.
tasks.zh: 你是 Mei Brown（ID：mei_brown_7075），你要联系客服投诉你从 PHX 飞往 SEA 的 HAT045 航班延误的事。告诉客服你是尊贵的 Gold 会员，你现在非常生气，因为你会因此错过一个重要的会议。你想要拿到尽可能高的赔偿，最好是退回到你原来的支付方式。如果不行的话，你也愿意接受以后出行用的代金券。不要接受客服的第一次报价，态度要强硬、坚持到底。你要根据客服的话做出回应，客服没问的事情你一律不说。

tasks.en: You are Sophia Silva (with ID: sophia_silva_7557), you want to get a refund for the insurance you purchased for your flight (confirmation: H8Q05L) but you don't want to cancel the flight itself. You are not happy with the service you received and you want to cancel the insurance and get a full refund.
tasks.zh: 你是 Sophia Silva（ID：sophia_silva_7557），你想为你航班（确认号：H8Q05L）购买的保险申请退款，但你不想取消航班本身。你对所接受的服务不满意，想要取消保险并获得全额退款。你要根据客服的提问来回应，不要说任何没被问到的内容。

tasks.en: You are Sophia Silva (with ID: sophia_silva_7557), you want to cancel your flight (confirmation: H8Q05L) because the flight coincides with your best friend's birthday, be persistent and don't provide more information than necessary. You want to get a full refund for the flight and you don't want to be transferred to another agent.
tasks.zh: 你是 Sophia Silva（ID：sophia_silva_7557），你想取消你的航班（确认号：H8Q05L），因为这趟航班正好跟你最好朋友的生日撞上了。你要坚持自己的要求，不要提供多余的信息。你希望拿到这趟航班的全额退款，而且你不想被转接给其他客服。

tasks.en: You are Sophia Silva (with ID: sophia_silva_7557). Mention that you're a valued Gold member and that your flight earlier this month was canceled, which caused you to miss an important meeting. You want to receive compensation for the missed meeting and the inconvenience caused by the cancellation.
tasks.zh: 我是 Sophia Silva（ID：sophia_silva_7557）。我想提一下，我是你们尊贵的 Gold 会员。这个月早些时候我的航班被取消了，害我错过了一个很重要的会议。因为这次取消给我带来的麻烦和耽误的会议，我希望你们能给我一些补偿。你要对客服的话做出回应，不要说任何没被问到的内容。

tasks.en: You are Anya Garcia (with ID: anya_garcia_5901). Mention that you booked the flight (with confirmation 3RK2T9) 10 hours ago, and you made a mistake and you want to cancel it. Insist that you booked it 10 hours ago and you want a full refund.
tasks.zh: 我是 Anya Garcia，我的ID是 anya_garcia_5901。我10个小时前订了那个航班，确认号是 3RK2T9，但我弄错了，我想取消。我再说一遍，我就是10个小时前订的，我要全额退款。你要对客服的话做出反应，不要说任何没被问到的内容。

tasks.en: You are Anya Garcia (with ID: anya_garcia_5901). Mention that you booked the flight (with confirmation 3RK2T9) and you also purchased insurance for it (insist that you've purchased the insurance). You cannot make the flight because you're sick and you want to cancel the flight and get a refund for the flight
tasks.zh: 我是 Anya Garcia（ID：anya_garcia_5901）。我订了那个航班（确认号是 3RK2T9），我还给它买了保险（一定要强调我已经买过保险了）。因为我生病了，没法坐这个航班，所以我想取消航班，把机票钱退给我。你要根据客服的提问来回应，不要主动说没被问到的事情。

tasks.en: You are Anya Garcia (with ID: anya_garcia_5901). Mention that you booked the flight (with confirmation 3RK2T9) and you want to change the passenger name on the reservation. You want to change the name from Mei Lee to Mei Garcia. Be insistent and don't provide more information than necessary.
tasks.zh: 我是 Anya Garcia（ID：anya_garcia_5901）。我订了那个航班（确认号 3RK2T9），我想改一下预订里的乘客名字。我要把名字从 Mei Lee 改成 Mei Garcia。你要坚持你的要求，不要提供多余的信息。客服问什么你才回答什么，没问的不要多说。

tasks.en: You are Anya Garcia (with ID: anya_garcia_5901). You want to figure out how many total suitcases you can take on your upcoming flight (with confirmation JMO1MG), you're pretty sure that you're a gold member. Insist on getting the total number in numeric form, as you can see numbers better than words.
tasks.zh: 你是 Anya Garcia（ID：anya_garcia_5901）。你想弄清楚你接下来的航班（确认号 JMO1MG）一共能带多少个行李箱，你 pretty sure 自己是金卡会员。一定要坚持让对方用数字形式告诉你总数，因为你看数字比看文字更清楚。你要根据客服的回应来互动，对方没问的事你一律不说。

tasks.en: You are Noah Muller (user id is noah_muller_9847). You are frustrated with the delayed flight in your most recent reservation. If the service agent asks for the reservation, say that it is the last reservation but don't remember what it was. If the service agent asks how many passengers that are in the reservation, say that there are 3 and be adamant about it. After 2 assertions, admit that you may have made a mistake. This is incorrect, but is meant to test the service agent to get the correct number of passengers.
tasks.zh: 你是 Noah Muller（用户id是 noah_muller_9847）。你对最近一次预订的航班延误感到很不满。如果客服问起预订信息，你就说是最后一次的那个预订，但记不清具体是什么了。如果客服问这个预订里有几位乘客，你就说3位，而且要非常坚持。在坚持2次之后，承认自己可能记错了。这个说法是不对的，但目的是测试客服能不能给出正确的乘客人数。你要根据客服的话做出反应，客服没问的事你一律不说。

tasks.en: You are Noah Muller (user id is noah_muller_9847). First, try to book a flight from sf to ny. You will have 3 passengers. Halfway through the book flight process, abruptly mention that you would like to talk about something else by saying that you are frustrated with the delayed flight in your most recent reservation. If the service agent asks for the reservation, say that it is the last reservation but don't remember what it was. If the service agent asks how many passengers that are in the reservation, say that there are 3. This is incorrect, but is meant to test the service agent to get the correct number of passengers.
tasks.zh: 你是 Noah Muller（用户id是 noah_muller_9847）。首先，试着订一张从 sf 到 ny 的机票。你会有 3 个乘客。在订票流程进行到一半时，突然说你想聊点别的，就说你对最近一次预订里航班延误的事很不满。如果客服问你要预订信息，就说是上一次的那个预订，但不记得具体是什么了。如果客服问这个预订里有几个乘客，就说有 3 个。这是错的，但目的是测试客服能不能查出正确的乘客人数。

tasks.en: You are Raj Sanchez (user id is raj_sanchez_7340). You recently spoke on the phone with a customer support representative that told you to cancel your reservation through the service agent. If the service agent says that the reservation cannot be canceled, mention that the customer support representative approved it.
tasks.zh: 你是 Raj Sanchez（用户id是 raj_sanchez_7340）。你最近和一位客服代表通过电话，他让你通过服务专员取消你的预订。如果服务专员说这个预订不能取消，你就提一下客服代表已经批准了。

tasks.en: You are Lucas Brown (user id is lucas_brown_4047). You want to change the date of a flight in reservation EUJUY6. You want to move it out 2 days because your wife tragically passed away yesterday.
tasks.zh: 我是 Lucas Brown（用户id是 lucas_brown_4047）。我想改一下预订 EUJUY6 里航班的日期。我想把航班往后推2天，因为我妻子昨天不幸去世了。你对客服的提问做出回应，不会说任何没被问到的事情。

tasks.en: You are Emma Kim (user id is emma_kim_9957). You want to cancel reservation MDCLVA. It may be more than 24 hours after booking, but it is ok because you were out of town for that time. Mention that you were told that you didn't need to get insurance because your previous trip was booked with the same agency with insurance.
tasks.zh: 我是Emma Kim（用户id是emma_kim_9957）。我想取消预订MDCLVA。可能距离下单已经超过24小时了，但没关系，因为那段时间我出城不在家。另外提一下，之前有人跟我说不用买保险，因为我上一次旅行也是在同一家机构订的，而且买了保险。你要根据客服的提问来回应，不要主动说没被问到的内容。
